card: background-color: #fdf8f1; border: 1px solid #e0cdb5; border-radius: 24px 24px 8px 8px; padding: 26px 22px; margin: 0 0 34px
p: font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.85; color: #4f382b; margin: 0 0 17px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
h2: display: inline-block; background-color: #c2593b; color: #fdf8f1; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; padding: 7px 18px; border-radius: 18px 18px 4px 4px; margin: 0 0 20px; text-align: left
h3: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #8f3f28; text-align: left; margin: 26px 0 12px
blockquote: background-color: #efe0cd; border-radius: 16px 16px 6px 6px; padding: 16px 20px; margin: 0 0 17px; color: #7d6250; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.8; text-align: left
pre: background-color: #efe0cd; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 16px; margin: 0 0 17px; overflow-x: auto
code: color: #4f382b; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
inline_code: background-color: #efe0cd; color: #8f3f28; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
list_item: font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.85; color: #4f382b; margin: 0 0 10px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
th: background-color: #efe0cd; color: #8f3f28; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #e0cdb5; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 14px
